verdict.rationale: First-party PR-review docs say you can apply suggested changes to the PR with a single click, without copy-paste or switching context. Other docs show CodeRabbit generates the code changes to fix the issues it finds, posts inline suggested fixes (including for CI failures), and offers one-click agentic fixes for review findings. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the committable suggestion-diff format and which Git platforms support it, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of one-click apply.
